task1.title: Sports participation trends
task1.prompt: The graph below shows the number of people taking part in four different kinds of sports in a particular region between 1985 and 2005.

chartDesc.overview: Rugby experienced a steep decline over the period to become the least popular sport by 2005, whereas Tennis saw a steady rise to become the most popular. Basketball and Badminton participation remained largely stable.
unreadable: Exact numerical data labels above individual data points (values estimated from y-axis scale)
keyFeatures: Rugby dropped dramatically from 240 in 1985 to 50 in 2005.
Tennis steadily climbed from 150 in 1985 to reach 230 in 2005.
Tennis and Rugby crossed in 1995 when both had 200 participants.
Badminton and Basketball showed minimal change, staying around 50 and 75-80 respectively throughout the 20-year period.
In 2005, Rugby and Badminton tied at the lowest point of 50.

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparison where relevant.
task1.sampleBand5:
The graph shows information about four kinds of sports people did from 1985 to 2005. It is about a particular area.

In 1985, tennis was the most popular. Then, the number of people playing tennis went up and down. Swimming was also popular, and the number of people swimming stayed about the same for the whole time. Football was less popular at the start, but it increased a lot.

Cycling was the least popular sport in 1985. After that, more people started cycling. Football became more popular than tennis after 1995. The number of people doing swimming was always higher than cycling. In 2005, football was the most popular sport. More people liked football than other sports.

Overall, the sports changed in popularity. Football became more popular, and tennis became less popular. Swimming was pretty steady.
task1.sampleBand6:
The line graph illustrates the number of participants in four different sports in a region over a 20-year period, from 1985 to 2005.

Overall, it is clear that swimming was the most popular sport throughout the period, while tennis saw the least participation. Also, the numbers for both football and badminton experienced a rise, while the trend for swimming was downward.

In 1985, swimming had approximately 80 participants, but this gradually decreased to around 60 by 2005. Football started with around 25 participants and increased to about 55 in 2005. Similarly, badminton saw an increase from approximately 30 to 40 participants during the same timeframe.

Tennis, on the other hand, remained relatively low, with the number of people staying below 20 for the duration. Although there were some fluctuations, the overall participation in tennis did not see much significant change.
task1.sampleBand7:
The line graph illustrates the participation rates in four different sports across a region over the two decades between 1985 and 2005.

Overall, while swimming and cycling showed an upward trend, the numbers for football and badminton experienced fluctuations. It is also noticeable that football was consistently the most popular sport throughout the period.

In 1985, football had the highest participation rate at around 70,000 people. This figure remained relatively stable until 1995 before declining slightly to approximately 65,000 in 2005. Conversely, swimming saw a steady increase, rising from about 25,000 participants in 1985 to around 50,000 in 2005. Similarly, cycling also increased, though less dramatically, from 30,000 to 45,000 over the same period.

Badminton, on the other hand, presented a more erratic pattern. Starting at 40,000 participants in 1985, it dipped to 30,000 in 1995 before rebounding to 40,000 again in 2005. This made it the least popular sport at the end of the period, despite its initial popularity. The growth of swimming and cycling outpaced the other two sports.
task1.sampleBand8:
The line graph illustrates the participation rates in four distinct sports within a specific region over a twenty-year period, commencing in 1985 and concluding in 2005. Overall, while participation in swimming and tennis experienced growth, the popularity of football and badminton declined.

Initially, football was the most popular sport, with approximately 80,000 participants in 1985. However, this figure underwent a steady decline, falling to around 55,000 by 2005. Badminton followed a similar downward trend, decreasing from approximately 60,000 participants in 1985 to roughly 45,000 in 2005. Conversely, swimming saw a substantial increase in popularity. Starting at around 25,000 participants, it witnessed a gradual but consistent rise, eventually surpassing badminton and football to reach approximately 70,000 participants by the end of the period.

Tennis also experienced a positive trajectory, albeit less dramatic than swimming. The number of people engaging in tennis rose from roughly 30,000 in 1985 to approximately 50,000 in 2005. It is worth noting that in the late 1990s, tennis participation briefly plateaued before resuming its upward climb. In conclusion, the trends reveal a shift in sporting preferences, with individual sports like swimming and tennis gaining ground at the expense of team sports such as football and badminton. The fluctuations observed underscore the dynamic nature of recreational activities. A salient feature is the inverse relationship between the declining sports and the sports that increased in popularity.
task1.sampleBand9:
The line graph illustrates participation rates in four distinct sports within a specific region over a twenty-year period, from 1985 to 2005. A cursory glance reveals a general upward trend in participation across all sports, with swimming and cycling exhibiting the most significant increases.

In 1985, swimming had the lowest participation rate, starting at approximately 20%. However, it experienced a dramatic surge throughout the period, ultimately becoming the most popular sport by 2005, reaching nearly 70%. Similarly, cycling saw a substantial increase, rising from around 35% in 1985 to approximately 65% in 2005. Football, while consistently popular, demonstrated a more moderate growth trajectory, increasing from approximately 55% to just over 60% during the same timeframe.

Running, conversely, presented a somewhat different picture. Although it started with a relatively high participation rate of around 60% in 1985, it fluctuated slightly before settling at approximately 55% in 2005. This made it the only sport to show a slight decline over the period. Overall, the data unequivocally indicates a growing interest in sports participation, with swimming and cycling gaining considerable traction among the population, while football maintained its popularity, and running remained relatively stable.

In summary, while all sports enjoyed some level of participation, the relative popularity shifted significantly, indicating evolving preferences in recreational activities over the two decades. This dynamic landscape highlights the changing sporting interests in the region.
task1.sampleAnswer:
The line graph illustrates the participation rates in four types of sports—tennis, badminton, rugby, and hockey—in a specific region from 1985 to 2005. Overall, tennis and badminton witnessed considerable fluctuations, while rugby and hockey followed a more stable pattern of growth and decline respectively.

In 1985, tennis was the most popular sport, with approximately 350 participants. This figure dropped significantly to around 200 by 1995 before recovering slightly to end at nearly 250 in 2005. Badminton showed an opposite trend, starting at a modest 100 participants and rising dramatically to peak at around 400 in the mid-1990s, before declining sharply to approximately 250 by 2005.

Meanwhile, rugby, which began with roughly 200 participants, experienced steady growth throughout the period, reaching a high of 350 by 2005, making it the most popular sport by the end of the period. In stark contrast, hockey saw a consistent decline from its initial level of 300 participants to approximately 150 by the end of the twenty-year period. By 2005, rugby had overtaken all other sports in popularity, while hockey had become the least favored activity.

Grafikda 1985 yildan 2005 yilgacha odamlar bilan shug'ullangan to'rt xil sport turi haqida ma'lumotlar ko'rsatilgan. Bu muayyan hudud haqida.

1985 yilda tennis eng mashhur edi. Keyin tennis o'ynaydigan odamlar soni ko'tarilib tushdi. Suzish ham mashhur edi va suzuvchilar soni deyarli bir xil bo'lib qoldi butun vaqt davomida. Futbol boshida unchalik mashhur emas edi, lekin u juda ko'paydi.

Velosipedda uchish 1985 yilda eng kam mashhur sport edi. Shundan keyin, ko'proq odamlar velosipedda ucha boshladilar. Futbol 1995 yildan keyin tennisdan ko'ra mashhurroq bo'ldi. Suzish bilan shug'ullanuvchilar soni har doim velosipedda uchuvchilardan yuqori edi. 2005 yilda futbol eng mashhur sport edi. Ko'proq odamlar futbolni boshqa sport turlaridan ko'ra yaxshi ko'rishdi.

Umuman olganda, sport turlarining mashhurligi o'zgardi. Futbol yanada ommalashdi, tennis esa unchalik emas. Suzish ancha barqaror edi.

Umuman olganda, suzish butun davr mobaynida eng ommabop sport turi bo'lgani, tennisda esa ishtirok eng kam bo'lgani aniq. Shuningdek, futbol va badminton bo'yicha raqamlar o'sishni boshdan kechirdi, suzish bo'yicha tendensiya esa pasayish tomonga edi.

1985-yilda suzishda taxminan 80 nafar ishtirokchi bo'lgan, ammo bu ko'rsatkich asta-sekin kamayib, 2005-yilga kelib 60 atrofida bo'ldi. Xuddi shunday, badminton ham xuddi shu vaqt oralig'ida taxminan 30 nafardan 40 nafargacha ishtirokchining o'sishini ko'rdi.

Boshqa tomondan, tennis nisbatan past darajada qoldi, odamlar soni butun davr mobaynida 20 dan pastda qoldi. Garchi ba'zi tebranishlar bo'lgan bo'lsa-da, tennisda umumiy ishtirok sezilarli o'zgarishni ko'rmadi.
task1.uzSampleBand7:
Chiziqli grafika 1985 yildan 2005 yilgacha bo'lgan ikki o'n yillik davomida mintaqa bo'ylab to'rtta turli sport turida ishtirok etish darajasini ko'rsatadi.

Umuman olganda, suzish va velosportda o'sish tendensiyasi kuzatilgan bo'lsa, futbol va badminton ko'rsatkichlari o'zgarishlarni boshdan kechirdi. Shuni ham ta'kidlash joizki, futbol butun davr davomida eng mashhur sport turi bo'lib qoldi.

1985 yilda futbol eng yuqori ishtirok darajasiga ega bo'lib, taxminan 70 000 kishini tashkil etdi. Aksincha, suzishda doimiy o'sish kuzatildi, 1985 yildagi 25 000 ga yaqin ishtirokchidan 2005 yilda 50 000 ga yaqinga ko'tarildi. Xuddi shunday, velosport ham oshdi, ammo unchalik keskin emas, xuddi shu davrda 30 000 dan 45 000 gacha.

Boshqa tomondan, badminton yanada tartibsiz naqshni namoyish etdi. 1985 yilda 40 000 ishtirokchidan boshlangan holda, u 1995 yilda 30 000 gacha tushdi, so'ngra 2005 yilda yana 40 000 gacha ko'tarildi. Bu uni davr oxirida eng kam mashhur sport turiga aylantirdi, dastlabki mashhurligiga qaramay. Suzish va velosportning o'sishi qolgan ikkita sport turidan tezroq o'tdi.

task2.title: Luck and personal success
task2.prompt: Whether or not someone achieves their aims is mostly by a question of luck. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
task2.instruction: To what extent do you agree or disagree?
task2.sampleBand5:
Some people think that if you want to achieve something, it is mostly about luck. I don't really agree with this because I think hard work is more important, but luck can help sometimes.

If you want to be successful, you need to work hard. For example, if you want to be a doctor, you need to study a lot and go to school for many years. It is not enough to just be lucky, you have to really try hard and learn everything you need to know. Also, if you want to be good at a sport, you need to practice all the time. You can't just hope that you will win because you are lucky. You need to train and work hard to get better.

However, I think luck can also play a part. Sometimes, you might be in the right place at the right time, and that can help you to achieve your goals. For example, you might meet someone who can help you get a job, or you might find a good opportunity that other people don't. But even if you are lucky, you still need to be prepared to work hard and take advantage of the opportunity.

In conclusion, I think that hard work is more important than luck when it comes to achieving your aims. While luck can sometimes help, it is not the main thing that determines whether or not you will be successful. You need to be prepared to work hard and put in the effort if you want to achieve your goals, but luck is okay.
task2.sampleBand6:
It is often said that success in life is mostly a matter of luck. While I agree that chance can play a role, I believe that hard work and determination are more significant factors in achieving one's goals. Luck can certainly open doors, but it is what you do with those opportunities that truly matters.

On the one hand, there are situations where luck undeniably plays a crucial role. For instance, winning the lottery or inheriting a large sum of money can instantly change someone's life. Similarly, being in the right place at the right time can lead to unexpected career advancements. These examples show how fortunate circumstances can significantly impact someone's trajectory. However, these are exceptions rather than the rule.

On the other hand, hard work and perseverance are essential ingredients for success. Many successful people have faced numerous obstacles and setbacks along the way. Their achievements are not simply due to luck, but rather to their unwavering commitment and willingness to learn from their mistakes. For example, many entrepreneurs face failures before they finally achieve success, and this shows that luck alone isn't enough.

Furthermore, even if someone is lucky enough to receive an advantage, they still need to possess the necessary skills and knowledge to capitalize on it. For example, a talented musician may get a lucky break with a record label, but they still need to work hard to hone their craft and produce quality music. Without dedication, their initial luck will not translate into long-term success.

In conclusion, while luck can undoubtedly play a part in achieving one's aims, I believe that it is ultimately hard work, determination, and the ability to seize opportunities that truly determine success. People should not rely on luck alone, but rather take control of their lives and work towards their goals.
task2.sampleBand7:
The assertion that success is primarily determined by luck is a viewpoint I largely disagree with. While chance undoubtedly plays a role in shaping individual destinies, it is far from being the sole or even the most significant determinant. Personal attributes such as diligence, strategic planning, and resilience, coupled with favorable circumstances, are, in my opinion, more crucial factors.

On the one hand, the influence of luck cannot be entirely dismissed. Some individuals are born into privilege, granting them access to superior educational opportunities and influential networks, advantages that others may never have. Similarly, being in the right place at the right time can open doors to unforeseen opportunities. For example, someone might unexpectedly encounter an investor who believes in their business idea, leading to rapid success. These instances highlight the role of chance encounters and pre-existing advantages.

However, to attribute success solely to luck overlooks the critical importance of individual effort and skill. A person with a brilliant idea but lacking the dedication to develop it will likely fail. Furthermore, strategic planning and adaptability are essential for navigating challenges and maximizing opportunities. Consider, for instance, two individuals who both receive funding for a startup. One meticulously plans their business model and adapts to market changes, while the other relies solely on the initial investment and fails to innovate. The former is far more likely to succeed, regardless of any initial luck involved.

Furthermore, resilience in the face of setbacks is a key determinant of long-term success. Many successful individuals have faced numerous failures before achieving their goals. Their ability to learn from these experiences and persevere is often more crucial than initial good fortune. The ability to bounce back from adversity demonstrates the power of personal character over the whims of fate.

In conclusion, while luck can undoubtedly influence one's path, it is not the overriding factor in achieving aims. Personal qualities, strategic planning, and resilience are far more important. While some may benefit from fortunate circumstances, ultimately, it is the combination of effort and adaptability that paves the way for true success.
task2.sampleBand8:
The debate surrounding the relative importance of luck versus effort in achieving one's goals is a perennial one. While I acknowledge that serendipitous events can undoubtedly play a role, I strongly disagree with the assertion that success is *mostly* a matter of luck. I believe that diligence, strategic planning, and resilience are far more critical determinants of outcome.

Undeniably, chance encounters and unforeseen opportunities can alter the trajectory of one's life. For instance, a struggling artist might gain recognition through a chance meeting with an influential gallery owner. Similarly, a scientist might stumble upon a groundbreaking discovery due to an unforeseen anomaly in their experiment. These instances, however, are exceptions rather than the rule. To suggest that such occurrences are the *primary* drivers of success is to diminish the significance of sustained effort and meticulous preparation.

Conversely, countless examples demonstrate that success is primarily the result of hard work and strategic thinking. Consider the meteoric rise of entrepreneurs like Elon Musk or Jeff Bezos. While they may have benefited from certain advantages, their achievements are fundamentally rooted in relentless dedication, innovative thinking, and a willingness to take calculated risks. Furthermore, even in fields seemingly governed by luck, such as professional sports, the sheer volume of training and practice required to reach the elite level underscores the paramount importance of effort. Athletes must consistently hone their skills, push their physical limits, and develop robust mental fortitude to compete at the highest levels.

Moreover, the ability to capitalize on opportunities, even those that arise by chance, is itself a product of preparation and proactive engagement. A skilled negotiator, for example, is more likely to leverage a chance encounter into a lucrative deal than someone who lacks the requisite skills. Similarly, a well-prepared student is more likely to excel on an exam, even if they encounter a question that they were not specifically expecting. This proactive element is crucial in transforming potential luck into tangible success.

In conclusion, while luck may occasionally play a role in shaping one's destiny, it is ultimately sustained effort, strategic planning, and the ability to adapt to changing circumstances that pave the path to achievement. To attribute success primarily to luck is to ignore the immense power of human agency and the transformative potential of hard work.

task2.sampleAnswer:
The debate over whether success is primarily a product of luck or personal endeavor has persisted for centuries. While I acknowledge that fortune can play a role in achieving one's goals, I largely disagree with the assertion that success is predominantly a matter of chance. In my view, hard work, strategic planning, and perseverance are far more significant determinants of success.

Admittedly, luck can occasionally provide unexpected opportunities. Being in the right place at the right time, meeting an influential person by chance, or stumbling upon a groundbreaking idea can all accelerate one's path to success. For example, many successful entrepreneurs recount stories of a chance encounter that led to a crucial business partnership. These anecdotes suggest that an element of randomness can indeed influence outcomes.

However, to attribute success primarily to luck undermines the enormous effort individuals invest in their pursuits. Athletes train for years to perfect their skills, students study diligently to pass exams, and professionals work long hours to excel in their careers. These achievements are not the result of fortuitous events but the culmination of dedication and discipline. Furthermore, those who are 'lucky' enough to receive an opportunity often fail to capitalize on it if they are not adequately prepared. Luck might open a door, but it is skill and hard work that allow one to walk through it.

In conclusion, while luck may occasionally present favorable circumstances, I firmly believe that success is largely the outcome of consistent effort and resilience. Attributing achievements solely to luck diminishes the value of human agency and the power of determination.
task2.uzSampleBand5:
Ba'zi odamlar biror narsaga erishmoqchi bo'lsangiz, bu asosan omadga bog'liq deb o'ylashadi. Men bunga unchalik qo'shilmayman, chunki menimcha qattiq mehnat muhimroq, lekin omad ba'zan yordam berishi mumkin.

Agar muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishni istasangiz, qattiq mehnat qilishingiz kerak. Misol uchun, agar shifokor bo'lishni istasangiz, ko'p o'qishingiz va ko'p yillar davomida o'qishingiz kerak. Faqat omadli bo'lish yetarli emas, siz haqiqatan ham qattiq harakat qilishingiz va bilishingiz kerak bo'lgan hamma narsani o'rganishingiz kerak. Shuningdek, agar siz sportda yaxshi bo'lishni istasangiz, doimo mashq qilishingiz kerak. Shunchaki omadli bo'lganingiz uchun g'alaba qozonaman deb umid qila olmaysiz. Yaxshiroq bo'lish uchun mashq qilishingiz va qattiq mehnat qilishingiz kerak.

Biroq, menimcha, omad ham rol o'ynashi mumkin. Ba'zan, siz to'g'ri joyda to'g'ri vaqtda bo'lishingiz mumkin va bu sizning maqsadlaringizga erishishga yordam berishi mumkin. Misol uchun, sizga ish topishga yordam beradigan kimnidir uchratishingiz mumkin yoki siz yaxshi imkoniyatni topishingiz mumkin, boshqa odamlar topa olmaydigan. Lekin omadli bo'lsangiz ham, qattiq ishlashga va imkoniyatdan foydalanishga tayyor bo'lishingiz kerak.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, menimcha maqsadlaringizga erishishda qattiq mehnat omaddan muhimroqdir. Omad ba'zan yordam berishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, bu sizning muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishingizni belgilaydigan asosiy narsa emas. Agar siz maqsadlaringizga erishmoqchi bo'lsangiz, qattiq mehnat qilishga va kuch sarflashga tayyor bo'lishingiz kerak, lekin omad ham yaxshi.
task2.uzSampleBand6:
Ko'pincha hayotda muvaffaqiyat asosan omadga bog'liq, deb aytiladi. Men tasodif rol o'ynashi mumkinligiga qo'shilsam-da, muvaffaqiyatga erishishda qattiq mehnat va qat'iyatlilik muhimroq omillar deb hisoblayman. Omad albatta eshiklarni ochishi mumkin, ammo asl muhimi, siz bu imkoniyatlardan qanday foydalanishingizdir.

Bir tomondan, omad shubhasiz muhim rol o'ynaydigan vaziyatlar mavjud. Misol uchun, lotereyada yutish yoki katta miqdordagi pulni meros qilib olish bir zumda kimningdir hayotini o'zgartirishi mumkin.
